title: Absolute Catwoman #4
desc:
CENTRAL CITY OVERRUN WITH HORRORS!

Selina Kyle and the Calicos join forces for one last heist to find the Yarn before Cassandra Cain and the League of Shadows do.

With their futures hanging in the balance, it'll require more than just top-of-the-line gear to get their hands on the world's most powerful supercomputer.
